market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and CPI reacceleration drive rate expectations higher, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. 4th straight loss day suggests momentum shift. Fed 25bps hike likely within 2-3 weeks. Volatility elevated; expect range-bound with downside risk if oil breaches $115. CPI data this week is critical catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for energy, AI infrastructure, and essential goods. Structural themes: energy transition tension (renewables overcapacity vs oil disruption), AI governance maturation, critical minerals race. Consumer spending under pressure through 2027 if rates stay elevated. Private credit consolidation likely. 9/11 rebuilding narrative supports NYC real estate recovery (SL Green, KBW).
